يعتليان (form VIII)
# يَعْتَلِيَانِ (yaʕtaliyāni) /jaʕ.ta.li.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
# يُعْتَلَيَانِ (yuʕtalayāni) /juʕ.ta.la.jaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَلَى (iʕtalā)
